name: v0.31.2 - update certifi to mitigate eMudhra compromise
body:
## What's Changed
* chore(mcp): require graphiti-core 0.31.1 and set MCP version to 1.1.1 by @devin-ai-integration[bot] in https://github.com/getzep/graphiti/pull/2013
* chore(ci): add the Devin bot to the CLA allowlist by @danielchalef in https://github.com/getzep/graphiti/pull/2028
* docs: state the security scope of the reference MCP and REST servers by @danielchalef in https://github.com/getzep/graphiti/pull/2029
* fix(servers): listen only on localhost by default by @danielchalef in https://github.com/getzep/graphiti/pull/2032
* docs: state that the MCP and REST servers are reference-only by @mehulp93 in https://github.com/getzep/graphiti/pull/2035
* fix(neptune): apply group filters in fulltext search and bind list parameters by @danielchalef in https://github.com/getzep/graphiti/pull/2031
* fix(core): keep restated facts and rebuild summaries in remove_episode by @danielchalef in https://github.com/getzep/graphiti/pull/2025
* fix(core): record supported edges on episodes in add_episode_bulk by @danielchalef in https://github.com/getzep/graphiti/pull/2030
* Update certifi to 2026.10.19 by @pevans in https://github.com/getzep/graphiti/pull/2042
* Set graphiti-core to 0.31.2 and the MCP server to 1.1.2, and require certifi 2026.10.19 by @pevans in https://github.com/getzep/graphiti/pull/2045


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/getzep/graphiti/compare/v0.31.1...v0.31.2
